title: Ellington's package of dance acts and talent scouts
summary: Ellington carried varied dance acts like the Five Blazes and Chuck and Chuckles, which inspired his music and exposed them to Hollywood talent scouts.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: This was also dancing with his show?

Excuse me. You all had a difference in your dancing that Duke would travel with, say, three or four different groups -- you and Chuckles, Five Blazes -- they all had -- what, were they all one eccentric style and the other one was perhaps soft shoe, or jazz. I mean, were they all different?
Yes, they was all very different, just like his melodies.
Because he wrote -- a lot of his
music seemed to -- dancers seemed to inspire the Duke.

Yes, yes. Well, he actually introduced these shows -- I mean these acts in his shows on his tours or appearances for the purpose of that, you see. Because you would never know how many talent scouts would be in an audience or who they were from or who they were representing. Of course, like he --
It was the in thing now, was it, for talent scouts to look for new black acts -- good black talents --
That's it, Hollywood calling. That's it.
